description: This file defines the class `RomPropertyPanel`, a Java Swing JPanel component used to display properties and metadata of a ROM object in the RomRaider application. It initializes UI components to show details such as filename, ECU revision, file size, make, model, and other attributes related to the ROM with data populated from a Rom object.
